 args=['/Users/baai/.local/bin/gh','api',('graphql' if payload is not None else url.split('https://api.github.com/',1)[-1])]

 result=subprocess.run(args,input=None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
 result.check_returncode();return json.loads(result.stdout)

 rows.append({'path':path,'bytes':size,'git_sha_verified':True})
report={**manifest,'observations':rows,'wall_seconds':elapsed,'all_verified':True}
